main_text.p: purum, formamus tertiam pluralem, interponendo, ante τῶ: ut,
main_text.head: Unde formatur primum perfectum tempus?
main_text.p: Ab actīvo, mutato φα & γκα in μμαι: ut, τίτυφα, τίτυμμαι. τέφαγκα, ostendi, τέφαμμαι, ostensus sum, τέφανσι, τέφαντες.
Χα in γμαι: ut, λέλεχα, dixi, λελεγμαι, dictus sum, λελεξαι, λέλεκται.
Κα modo in μαι, modo in σμαι: ut, ἐψαλκα, cantavi, ἐψαλμαι, cantatus sum, ἐψαλσαι, cantatus es, ἐψαλται, cantatus est.
Ἠκακα, audivi, ἠκουσμαι auditus sum, ἠκουσαι auditus es, ἠκουσται auditus est. [?]
main_text.head: Secundum perfectum tempus.
main_text.p: Εἴθε τεθέμην, utinam positus fuerim vel fuissem, τεθῇς, positus fueris vel fuisses, τεθῇ.

page.notes: Greek forms are set in a cursive italic Greek with many accents and breathings that are hard to read at this scan resolution; all Greek readings marked [?] are provisional, especially the breathings, accents and final letters of the verb forms. The first line of the page continues the previous page. The Greek in the right margin at the bottom ("ἐψίμι-") is the catchword. The dark marks on the left edge are scan shadow and were not transcribed.
